## TRA Timeline

#### Form-of TRA filed in abandoned IPO registration

- 2015-04-20?: Form-of TRA first filed as Exhibit 10.3 to S-1/A Amendment No. 1 (origin date inferred from earliest exhibit filing date; preamble dated `[ ], 2015`)
- 2015-06-15: Refiled form-of TRA in S-1/A Amendment No. 3 with terminology cleanup ("Corporate Taxpayer" standardized throughout) but no substantive change

#### Withdrawal

- 2016-03-23: Form RW filed withdrawing registration statement File No. 333-202797; no executed TRA ever came into existence

## Explanation

Wayne Farms, Inc. was an Up-C holding company incorporated by Continental Grain Company in 2015 to take Wayne Farms LLC public; the contemplated Tax Receivable Agreement would have paid Wayne Farms Holdings LLC (Continental Grain's holding vehicle) 85% of cash tax savings on basis step-ups from Class B unit exchanges, NOL utilization, and imputed interest. The form-of TRA was filed twice with the S-1/A registration (April 20, 2015 and June 15, 2015) but never executed: the IPO was abandoned and the registration was withdrawn via Form RW on March 23, 2016. SEC submissions metadata for CIK 0001636032 shows no 10-K, 10-Q, or 8-K was ever filed, consistent with the company never reaching effectiveness as a public registrant. The contract's status is Unknown because no executed instrument ever came into legal force. See `contract_log.md` for the form-of text references and the withdrawal-coverage note.
